title: Recording: Oo-Wee by Ringo Starr | 1974
content:
Sunset Sound Recorders, Los Angeles
Producer: Richard Perry
Engineer: Bill Schnee

Ringo Starr recorded ‘Oo-Wee’ for his fourth studio album, Goodnight Vienna, on 5 August 1974.

It was one of two songwriting collaborations on the album by Starr and Vini Poncia, the other being ‘All By Myself’.

The guitarist on the ‘Oo-Wee’ session was Dennis Coffey.

I was on an expedition in the high Sierras in Northern California on horseback. When I rode back to base camp I was surprised to hear there was a message waiting for me. The message was from a music contractor who wanted me to do a session for Ringo Starr…

Once I got to the studio I was surprised that the only two people there were me and Ringo. Richard Perry hadn’t arrived yet so Ringo and I had about an hour to visit. Since I had just come down from the mountains, I decided to share my recent adventures with Ringo. Ringo is a great drummer and a member of The Beatles, one of the most successful groups of all time, but he was kind enough to listen to my stories. Richard finally showed up driving a Bentley and wearing bib overalls. We then got down to business and completed the session.

Dennis Coffey
